info.title: Tripz Backend API
info.description: Multi-panel travel platform backend exposing Super Admin, Admin, Vendor, and Client surfaces. All authenticated endpoints expect a JWT access token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Every response is wrapped in a uniform `{ success, message, data }` (success) or `{ success: false, message, errors }` (error) envelope.

get.description: Returns a static identifier payload confirming the API is mounted.
Returns API health, process uptime, and current server timestamp.

post.description:
Generic file-upload endpoint. The backend forwards the file to Cloudinary and returns the public URL. **No database writes happen here** — caller stores the URL elsewhere (e.g., includes it in a later KYC submission).

Reusable for KYC documents (PAN/Aadhaar/GSTIN/CIN), company logos, avatars, etc. — pick the right `purpose` value.

Files are organized in Cloudinary as: `tripz/<purpose>/<userId>/<timestamp>-<filename>`.

file.description: The file to upload (max 5 MB, allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf).

purpose.description: Determines the Cloudinary folder. Frontend should set this based on which slot in the form is being filled.

400.description: Missing file, missing/invalid purpose, or empty file

value.message: File is required. Send multipart/form-data with a "file" field.

errors.message: purpose must be one of: kyc-pan, kyc-gstin, kyc-cin, kyc-aadhaar, company-logo, avatar, other

example.message: File too large. Max 5.0 MB allowed.
Unsupported file type: image/heic. Allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf

502.description: Cloudinary upload failed (transient — caller can retry)

post.summary: Register a new account (customer or agent)
post.description:
Single endpoint with an **identical payload for customers and agents**. Business details (country, company name, etc.) are collected later via the **Vendor KYC** flow, not at signup.

- `role: "customer"` → maps to internal `CLIENT`
- `role: "agent"` → maps to internal `VENDOR` (kycStatus starts as `PENDING`)

`ADMIN` and `SUPER_ADMIN` cannot be self-registered. User is created with `emailVerifiedAt = null`, an OTP is emailed, and **no tokens are issued** — call `/auth/verify-email` then `/auth/login`.

Agent.summary: Agent (vendor) sign-up — same fields as customer

example.message: Account registered. Please verify your email to continue.

403.description: Attempted to register a protected role

example.message: SUPER_ADMIN and ADMIN accounts cannot be created via public registration.

409.description: Email or phone already in use

value.message: An account with this email already exists.
An account with this phone number already exists.

post.description:
Validates credentials, returns an access/refresh token pair plus sanitized user data, **and sets the refresh token as an `httpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict` cookie scoped to `/api/v1/auth`** (path-scoped so it's only sent on auth endpoints).

**Storage advice for clients:**
- **Web:** ignore `refreshToken` in JSON, rely on the cookie. Keep `accessToken` in memory only (Redux/Zustand/Context).
- **Mobile/native:** there is no cookie — read `refreshToken` from JSON and store it in secure platform storage (Keychain/EncryptedSharedPreferences).

403.description: Account deactivated, or email not verified (a fresh OTP is sent automatically). When email is unverified the `errors` field includes `code: "EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED"` so the client can route the user to the OTP screen.

value.message: Email not verified. We have sent a new verification code to your inbox.

post.description:
Validates the 6-digit OTP previously sent to the user's email and marks the account as verified. Increments an attempt counter on wrong codes; after `OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (default 5) the code is invalidated and the user must request a new one.

**No auto-login** — verification confirms identity only. After success, the client must call `POST /auth/login` explicitly to establish a session.

200.description: Verified (or already verified — both return success)

value.message: Email verified successfully. Please log in to continue.
Verification code has expired. Please request a new one.
Too many incorrect attempts. Please request a new verification code.

post.description: Issues a fresh verification OTP for an unverified account. Returns a generic success message regardless of whether the email exists, to prevent account enumeration. Rate-limited by `OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` (default 60s) — too-soon requests return 429.

200.description: Generic success (sent OR no such email — same response)

example.message: If an account exists for that email, a verification code has been sent.

429.description: Cooldown not yet elapsed since previous send

example.message: Please wait 45s before requesting another code.

post.summary: Sign in (or sign up) with Google
post.description:
Single endpoint for all Google OAuth flows. The client obtains a Google ID token via Google Sign-In, posts it here, and receives the same access/refresh token pair as a normal login.

**Flow:**
- **Returning Google user** (matched by `sub`/googleId) → log in.
- **Existing email user, first time with Google** → auto-link the accounts (Google sets `authProvider: HYBRID` if the user has a password, else `GOOGLE`). Email is auto-verified since Google has already verified it.
- **Brand-new email** → create a new user. Requires `role` (`"customer"` or `"agent"`). New agents start with `kycStatus = PENDING` (same as the form flow).

Sets the `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie exactly like `/auth/login`.

NewAgent.summary: New agent signup (KYC still required afterward)

400.description: Missing role for new signup, or invalid request body

value.message: A `role` is required to create a new account. Pass role: "customer" or "agent".

401.description: Invalid/expired Google token, or Google email not verified

value.message: Your Google account email is not verified.

post.description:
Sends a 6-digit reset code to the user's email if (and only if) the email belongs to an active password-based account. **Always returns the same generic message** regardless of whether the email exists, the user signed up with Google (no password), or the account is deactivated — this prevents account enumeration.

Rate-limited by `OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` (default 60s).

200.description: Generic success (sent OR no such account — same response)

example.message: If an account exists for that email, a password reset code has been sent.

429.description: Cooldown not yet elapsed since previous send

example.message: Please wait 45s before requesting another reset code.

post.description:
Verifies the OTP and sets a new password. On success: (1) the OTP is consumed, (2) **ALL existing refresh tokens for the user are revoked** (everywhere-logout — critical security), (3) a 'password changed' confirmation email is sent.

**No auto-login.** The client must call `POST /auth/login` with the new password.

200.description: Password reset; all sessions logged out

example.message: Password reset successfully. Please log in with your new password.

value.message: Reset code has expired. Please request a new one.
Too many incorrect attempts. Please request a new reset code.

post.description:
Verifies the refresh token, rotates it (revoking the old one), and returns a fresh access/refresh pair. **Token may come from either the httpOnly `refreshToken` cookie (preferred for web) OR the JSON body (for mobile/API clients).** If both are missing, returns 400. Reuse of a rotated token revokes all sessions for that user.

Sets a fresh `refreshToken` cookie on success.

parameters.name: refreshToken
parameters.description: httpOnly cookie set by /auth/login. Web clients send this automatically with `credentials: 'include'`.

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked, or reused refresh token

example.message: Refresh token has expired. Please log in again.

post.summary: Log out (revoke refresh token + clear cookie)
post.description: Revokes the supplied refresh token and clears the httpOnly cookie. Token may come from either the cookie OR the JSON body. Idempotent — missing or already-revoked tokens still return success and clear the cookie.

get.description: Requires the caller to hold the `SUPER_ADMIN` role. Returns the authenticated user echo.

post.description: SuperAdmin creates an ADMIN account. The admin is created with `emailVerifiedAt` set (no OTP flow). The SuperAdmin sets the initial password and shares it with the admin out-of-band.

409.description: Email or phone already in use

get.description: Requires the caller to hold the `VENDOR` role.
Returns the vendor's current `kycStatus` and the latest submitted KYC payload (if any). When `kycStatus = REJECTED`, the `rejectionReason` is available so the vendor can fix and resubmit.

kyc.rejectionReason: Business address is incomplete — please provide full street, city, state, and postal code.

post.description: Vendor submits business details for admin review. Sets `kycStatus = SUBMITTED`. Resubmission after `REJECTED` clears prior review fields and re-enters the queue. Cannot submit while status is `SUBMITTED` (already in review) or `APPROVED` (contact support).

example.businessAddress: 123 MG Road, Andheri West, Mumbai, MH 400058

value.message: Your KYC is already approved. Contact support to update business details.
A KYC submission is already under review. Please wait for admin response.

422.description: Third-party document verification failed — submission was NOT saved. Vendor must correct the document numbers and resubmit.

example.message: Document verification failed: PAN (Invalid number format)

post.description: Real-time PAN verification. Calls the third-party provider (STUB until Surepass is wired in). On success, upserts the vendor's PAN `VendorKycDocument` with `thirdPartyVerified: true`. Returns the holder name from the provider.

422.description: Provider rejected the number (invalid format or not found)

example.message: PAN must be 5 letters + 4 digits + 1 letter (e.g., ABCDE1234F).

post.description: Real-time GSTIN verification. Same shape as `/verify/pan`. Returns the registered business name from the GST portal (via provider).
Real-time CIN verification (MCA registry via provider).

Initiates Aadhaar verification. Provider sends a one-time code to the user's Aadhaar-linked phone. The Aadhaar number is parked on the vendor's `VendorKycDocument` row as **unverified** — the next step flips it to verified.

**Mode depends on env config:**
- **LIVE** (`SUREPASS_TOKEN` set): Surepass sends a real SMS to the user's Aadhaar-linked phone. The server never sees the OTP.
- **STUB** (no `SUREPASS_TOKEN`): the OTP is printed to the server console — no SMS is sent. Use the logged value in `/confirm-otp`.

Returns a `sessionId` you must pass to `/confirm-otp` along with the OTP.

422.description: Provider could not initiate OTP (e.g., Aadhaar not linked to phone)

post.description: Verifies the OTP from step 1. On success, the parked Aadhaar `VendorKycDocument` flips to `thirdPartyVerified: true`. Wrong OTPs increment an attempt counter; after `OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (default 5) the session is burned and the vendor must request a new OTP.

400.description: Validation error OR no pending Aadhaar verification found (call send-otp first)

401.description: Invalid OTP, expired session, or too many attempts

get.description: Returns paginated vendor profiles with their latest KYC. Filter by `status` to see only `SUBMITTED` queue, `APPROVED` archive, etc.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by KYC status. Omit to see all.

post.description: Approves the SUBMITTED KYC for the given vendor `userId`. Vendor's `kycStatus` becomes `APPROVED` and they can now access KYC-gated routes.

400.description: Vendor is not in SUBMITTED state

post.description: Rejects the SUBMITTED KYC with a reason. Vendor's `kycStatus` becomes `REJECTED` and they may resubmit a corrected form.

example.reason: Business address is incomplete — please provide full street, city, state, and postal code.

get.description: Requires the caller to hold the `CLIENT` role.

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token issued by `/api/v1/auth/login` or `/api/v1/auth/refresh`.

errors.description: Optional structured error details (e.g. per-field validation errors).

phone.description: Null for users who signed up via Google (Google does not return phone). Required for password-based signups.

emailVerifiedAt.description: Timestamp the user verified their email. `null` until they complete `/auth/verify-email`. Auto-set for Google signups (Google already verifies).

avatarUrl.description: Profile picture URL — populated for Google users from the `picture` claim.

AuthProvider.description: LOCAL = email+password only. GOOGLE = Google OAuth only (no password). HYBRID = both methods linked to the same account.

otp.description: Numeric OTP delivered via email (default 6 digits).

newPassword.description: Must include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit.

password.description: Must include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit.

KycStatus.description: PENDING = signed up but not submitted. SUBMITTED = awaiting admin review. APPROVED = vendor can take work. REJECTED = vendor may resubmit.

documentUrl.description: URL of the uploaded document file (frontend uploads to cloud, sends URL here)

thirdPartyVerified.description: Automated third-party verification result on submission

thirdPartyProvider.description: STUB until real provider integrated (Surepass / IDfy / Zoop / etc)

SubmitKycRequest.description: Full wizard payload. Extra fields like `verifiedDocs` and `uploadedFiles` are tolerated but ignored — admin verification is server-managed and `uploadedFiles` is redundant with the explicit URL fields. `gstNumber` and `gstinNumber` are treated as the same field (gstinNumber preferred).

companyType.description: Accepts canonical enum or verbose label (e.g. 'Proprietorship Firm' → PROPRIETORSHIP).

companyLogo.description: URL of logo, pre-uploaded by frontend

gstNumber.description: Deprecated alias for gstinNumber (kept for frontend compat)

number.description: The PAN / GSTIN / CIN number. Server uppercases + format-checks before calling the verification provider.

sessionId.description: Returned by /send-otp — links the OTP to the Aadhaar number being verified.

url.description: Public CDN URL — store this in the relevant DB column on the next submission.

publicId.description: Cloudinary identifier — used for deletes/transforms later.

GoogleLoginRequest.description: Only `token` and `role` are read server-side. Any other fields (email, googleId, picture, etc.) are tolerated for client convenience but IGNORED — identity comes from the verified token payload only.

token.description: Google ID token (JWT) returned by Google Sign-In on the client. Verified server-side via google-auth-library.

role.description: Required only for first-time signup (no existing user by googleId or email). Existing users can omit this — the server uses their stored role.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Body is optional. If omitted, the server reads the `refreshToken` cookie set by /auth/login.

password: Password must be at least 8 characters long

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, or expired access token

Forbidden.description: Authenticated user does not have the required role(s)
